title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
shortDescription: A nimble top-down adventure that uses wall merging and flexible item access to make every dungeon invite creative routes.
highlights: The wall ability reframes maps as layered puzzles
Flexible item order lets players approach challenges with agency
keywords: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A leading Nintendo 3DS adventure selection for its elegant spatial design and approachable freedom.
